issues.legal_issue: The limitation period for a suit concerning ownership of the place where treasure was found does not govern a claim to the treasure brought within the period allowed for an earlier-stage suit to establish a right to the treasure.
material_facts: The Collector adjourned the treasure proceedings to allow the finders to institute a suit to establish their right to the treasure.
The finders instituted that suit within the period of adjournment, and the competing claimants were later added as defendants.
The competing claimants filed a counterclaim asserting title to the treasure.
No declaration that the treasure was ownerless was made.
issues.conclusion: The later-stage limitation provision did not apply to the suit brought within the adjournment period, and it did not bar the counterclaim.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 8 and 9 of the Indian Treasure Trove Act, 1878, a claimant may bring a suit to establish a right to the treasure within the period for which the Collector adjourns the hearing; when that suit is timely instituted, the stated grounds for declaring the treasure ownerless do not arise. Sections 13 and 14 concern a later-stage proceeding, after an ownerless declaration, to determine ownership of the place where the treasure was found for purposes of division under section 10. The one-month limit in section 14 applies to a suit following the Collector’s order under section 13, not to a suit under section 8. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: treasure_claim_proceeding and early_stage_treasure_claim_suit and suit_filed_within_adjournment_period and not ownerless_treasure_declaration

predicates.treasure_claim_proceeding: The proceeding arose from the discovery of treasure and claims by multiple people concerning it.
predicates.early_stage_treasure_claim_suit: A claimant brought a civil suit to establish a right to the treasure during the initial Collector proceeding.
predicates.suit_filed_within_adjournment_period: The claimant instituted the suit within the period for which the Collector had adjourned the hearing.
predicates.ownerless_treasure_declaration: The Collector declared the treasure ownerless.

issues.definition: When a treasure claim is brought in an initial-stage suit within the Collector’s adjournment period and no ownerless declaration has been made, the later-stage claim deadline does not bar that claim.

issues.legal_issue: A counterclaim is not barred merely because it is filed after the written defence when its cause of action accrued by the time the defence was delivered or was due, and the counterclaim is within the applicable limitation period.
material_facts: The competing claimants filed their written statement denying the plaintiffs’ claim and asserting title to the treasure.
After filing the written statement, the claimants filed a counterclaim seeking title to the treasure.
The cause of action for the counterclaim had arisen before the written statement was filed.
The counterclaim was filed within the applicable limitation period.
issues.conclusion: The counterclaim was maintainable notwithstanding that it was filed after the written statement.
issues.legal_principle: Order VIII, Rule 6A(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, does not prohibit filing a counterclaim after delivery of the written statement; it requires that the cause of action have accrued before the defendant delivered the defence or before the time limited for delivering it expired. Under section 3(2)(b) of the Limitation Act, 1963, a counterclaim is treated as a suit for limitation purposes, and Article 113 provides the applicable period where no other period is specified. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: civil_suit_with_counterclaim and counterclaim_filed_after_defence and counterclaim_cause_accrued_by_defence_deadline and counterclaim_within_applicable_limitation

predicates.civil_suit_with_counterclaim: A defendant in a civil suit asserted an independent claim against the plaintiff by counterclaim.
predicates.counterclaim_filed_after_defence: The defendant filed the counterclaim after delivering the written defence.
predicates.counterclaim_cause_accrued_by_defence_de: The cause of action for the counterclaim had accrued before the defence was delivered or before the time allowed for delivering it expired.
predicates.counterclaim_within_applicable_limitatio: The defendant filed the counterclaim within the limitation period applicable to that claim.

issues.definition: A defendant’s counterclaim remains maintainable despite being filed after the written defence if its cause of action accrued by the defence deadline and it was filed within the applicable limitation period.
